primary_topics: Foreword by CJP to the book of speeches of former Customs Commissioner Alberto 'Bert' David Lina (ADL), written April 27, 2018

The governing thesis: the one word that best personalizes ADL is LOVE -- his 'enormous, googolplex love' for work, companies, employees, country, golf, music, poor, God, daughters, grandchildren, and above all Sylvia

Three operative principles from Bert's career: Pakikisama (real personal relationships based on caring and mutual respect), time discipline, and being makulit (following through consistently and repetitively)
The ADL Cup golf tournament and the ADLS proposal: CJP proposes renaming the ADL Cup to ADLS (Alberto Delights in Loving Sylvia) -- the climactic tribute
sub_topics: Book description: 'this lessons-filled collection of speeches of former Customs Commissioner Alberto David Lina is a must-read for everyone'
ADL's education and credentials: BSBA with honors; passed CPA exam; credits school of hard knocks, grit, patience, determination, and God's care as the main sources of his success

Volume begins with 'things my professors never taught me': most successful entrepreneurs never depended on college education; Henry Sy, John Gokongwei, George Ty, Injap Sia, Steve Jobs and Bill Gates cited as examples

Two threads binding ADL's deepest thoughts: (1) always quotes relevant passages from the Holy Bible to spice speeches; finds eternal truth in timeless Biblical quotations applied to the agnostic world of business; (2) 'love, not just like, your work -- have a deep passion and enjoyment in what you chose to do for a living'

CJP and Bert's relationship: known since 1969 when Bert was a young auditor at L.C. Diaz and Company examining the books of Baron Travel Corporation; 'from being a Catholic ignoramus who did not know the three persons of the Holy Trinity, I graduated to the highest lay advisory council of the Pope' -- wait, that's from SA052; from those 'peso-and-centavo days', Bert rose from poor boy born in Tondo with roots in Laguna to Filipino taipan

ADL loves his work: 18 companies in logistics, outsourcing, communications, connectivity, films, creative designs, sports, entertainment, land transportation, tourist airport transfers, solar power, waste management, portalet system; his favorite buzz word: 'back haul' (fill cargo trucks with agricultural products at cheap prices after delivering regular cargo)

ADL loves his employees: calls them 'partners and collaborators, not alalays'; all 2,800 receive a free daily meal with healthy brown rice; production bonuses and profit shares for all regardless of rank; conversion to cash of unused sick leaves
ADL loves his country: twice accepted the Customs Commissioner position against CJP's advice (under GMA and Aquino III)
ADL loves golf: holds tournaments during company anniversaries and birthdays; generous even to erstwhile competitors like Transportation Secretary Arthur Tugade
ADL loves music: indefatigable funder of the Manila Symphony Orchestra; logistics sponsor of Philippine Philharmonic Orchestra and Metro Manila Concert Orchestra
ADL loves the poor: annual medical-surgical-dental missions; company blood-letting; supports Guiding Light Ministries of Aklan
ADL loves God: credits the Lord for everything; donated Carillons to Manila Cathedral, St. James Church Alabang, Naga City, San Pedro Laguna, Mandaue Cebu -- reminders of mortality
ADL loves his four daughters: April Rose, Donna May, Lucia Jane, Bertha Ann; sends roses on Valentines; prohibited boyfriends till after college
ADL loves his three grandchildren: Andrea Rose/Andy, Alberto Wynn/Alwyn, Aurelia Jole; only people who can countermand his orders

ADL loves Sylvia endearingly, tenderly and eternally: at 70 still has the drive of 30 but with Sylvia is always a 'swain of 20'; extraordinary birthday gifts: Jaguar car, Bösendorfer piano, pink gumamela variety from UPLB, Sylvia P. Lina Theater at De La Salle Zobel in Alabang
ADL Cup 28th: sequestered entire Ayala Greenfield Golf Course for one full day April 23; '28' refers to his mythical age whenever he professes love for Sylvia
ADLS proposal: CJP proposes renaming the ADL Cup to 'ADLS' -- 'Alberto Delights in Loving Sylvia'

stances.claim: The one word that best personalizes ADL is LOVE -- 'his enormous, googolplex love.' Not business acumen, not educational credentials, not connections -- but love, manifested in 14 distinct domains: work, companies, employees, country, golf, music, poor, God, daughters, grandchildren, and supremely, Sylvia. This is CJP's master analytical key, the same he uses in SC003 (ADL's eulogy).
stances.rhetorical_move: single-word-master-key: LOVE as the analytical engine that unlocks all other observations in the foreword
stances.confidence: asserted as CJP's culminating insight after contemplating ADL's career

stances.claim: Most successful entrepreneurs never depended on their college education -- Henry Sy, John Gokongwei, George Ty, Injap Sia, Steve Jobs and Bill Gates all dropped out to hone entrepreneurial skills. ADL's BSBA and CPA credentials are honorable but not the source of his success; the school of hard knocks, grit, patience, determination and God's care are.
stances.rhetorical_move: anti-credential-determinism argument: the named business giants as proof that formal education is neither necessary nor sufficient for entrepreneurial success
stances.confidence: asserted as the governing lesson of the book's opening chapter

stances.claim: ADL exemplifies the principle that 'love permeates everything' -- his business success is an expression of love, not separate from it. The ADL Cup's '28' (his mythical age when professing love to Sylvia) and the proposed ADLS rename are the comic but sincere culmination of this insight.
stances.rhetorical_move: love-as-business-philosophy: the personal and professional are not compartments but expressions of the same governing love

notable_anecdotes: The ADLS proposal: 'ADL means A Dynamo of Love. But may I respectfully propose that next year, the golf tournament be renamed from ADL to ADLS to mean Alberto Delights in Loving Sylvia.'
ADL's '28' mythology: the ADL Cup was the '28th.' CJP: 'I know that the 28 refers to his mythical age whenever he professes his love for Sylvia' -- at 70, he is always a 'swain of 20' with her.
Sylvia's extraordinary gifts: brand-new Jaguar car; brand-new Bösendorfer piano; special pink gumamela variety commissioned from UPLB; Sylvia P. Lina Theater at De La Salle Zobel in Alabang.
The Customs Commissioner twice (against CJP's advice): Bert accepted the tough job under both GMA and Aquino III -- 'against my advice' -- as a testament to his love for country.

The Carillon donations: to Manila Cathedral, St. James Church Alabang, Naga City, San Pedro Laguna, and Mandaue Cebu -- 'because they remind him of his mortality and total dependence on God's mercies and graces every time they chime.'

one_paragraph_summary: Written April 27, 2018 as the Foreword to ADL's book of speeches, this tribute by CJP identifies LOVE -- 'his enormous, googolplex love' -- as the one word that best personalizes Alberto 'Bert' David Lina. The book's opening chapter ('things my professors never taught me') acknowledges that most successful entrepreneurs never depended on college education -- Henry Sy, John Gokongwei, George Ty, Injap Sia, Steve Jobs and Bill Gates all dropped out -- and that Bert's BSBA with honors and CPA credentials are honorable but not his secret: the school of hard knocks, grit, patience, determination, and God's care are. Two threads bind his deepest thoughts: always quoting Holy Scripture to apply eternal truth to the business world, and 'love, not just like, your work.' CJP met Bert in 1969 when Bert was a young L.C. Diaz auditor examining the books of Baron Travel Corporation; from those 'peso-and-centavo days,' Bert -- born in Tondo with roots in Laguna -- rose to Filipino taipan. CJP then inventories ADL's 14 domains of love: work (18 companies including logistics, waste management, portalet systems; favorite buzz word: 'back haul'); employees (2,800 'partners and collaborators, not alalays'; free daily brown-rice meal; production bonuses regardless of rank; unused sick leave encashable); country (Customs Commissioner twice, against CJP's advice, under both GMA and Aquino III); golf, music, the poor, God (Carillon donations to five churches), daughters (April Rose, Donna May, Lucia Jane, Bertha Ann), grandchildren (only people who can countermand his orders), and above all Sylvia -- with extraordinary birthday gifts (Jaguar car, Bösendorfer piano, pink gumamela from UPLB, Sylvia P. Lina Theater at De La Salle Zobel). CJP observes that the '28' in the 28th ADL Cup refers to Bert's mythical age whenever he professes love to Sylvia, and proposes renaming the tournament ADLS -- 'Alberto Delights in Loving Sylvia.'
